quote: A driver shall not stop or suddenly decrease the speed of a vehicle without first giving an appropriate signal to the driver of any vehicle immediately to the rear.

activation.condition: Driver stops or suddenly decreases vehicle speed with a vehicle immediately to the rear.

obligation.description: First give an appropriate signal to the driver of a vehicle immediately to the rear.

timing.description: Observe actual signal onset before the stop or speed decrease.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Suddenness requires measured deceleration and context; no statutory numeric cutoff.
Signal form and visibility require original-source and human review.
The immediately rear recipient requires original actor/lane/gap review.

parameter_refs.name: observed_signal_frame
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: first original observed signal or unknown

parameter_refs.name: immediately_rear
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: same-lane requested following actor; original relation reviewed
